mechanism: Take last 100 M1 closes, struct.pack to bytes, zlib compress level 9; ratio=len(original)/len(compressed). Thresholds: ratio>=3.5 CLEAN (trade), >=2.5 VOLATILE (hold), <2.5 CHOPPY (hold). Structured price compresses; noise does not. Model-agnostic structure sensor before LSTM.
data_needed: Last 100 closes on 1-minute bars; zlib; thresholds 3.5/2.5 calibrated on crypto CFD history.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: BTCUSD, ETHUSD, XAUUSD; M1; 60s loop; prop-firm multi-account.
why_new_for_mis: Gives MIS a cheap, theory-light structure/noise regime bit from compression ratio alone—orthogonal to indicator or model confidence.
quote: Structured data compresses well. Random data compresses poorly.... ratio >= 3.5 -> CLEAN regime -> Market is structured, TRADE

mechanism: Stacked LSTM: 8 features×30 timesteps → 128-unit LSTM×2 with 40% dropout → Softmax BUY/SELL/HOLD. Features RSI14, MACD, MACD signal, BB upper/lower, Momentum10, ROC10, ATR14; Global Z-score. Offline walk-forward train, .pth inference <10ms on CPU.
data_needed: M1 OHLCV; 8 TA features; 30-bar window; PyTorch .pth; confidence threshold (default 0.70).
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: BTCUSD/ETHUSD CFD M1; also XAUUSD mentioned for EA attach.
why_new_for_mis: Concrete short-horizon sequence sensor with explicit HOLD class and confidence score MIS can fuse with regime gates.
quote: Input: 8 features x 30 time steps = 240 inputs per prediction.... Output: 3 classes (BUY, SELL, HOLD) via Softmax

mechanism: Sequential QuantumEdgeFilter: (1) Entropy/compression gate blocks ratio<2.8; (2) Interference=expert-army agreement ≥0.60 among 50 LSTMs; (3) Softmax confidence ≥0.55; (4) regime-adjusted prob=confidence×{1.2 VOLATILE, 0.8 CLEAN, 0.6 CHOPPY} ≥0.52; (5) EMA200 trend alignment unless conf≥0.85; (6) Kill Switch after 3 consecutive losses → 300s cooldown. Multiplicative selectivity.
data_needed: zlib entropy; 50-model vote interference; LSTM confidence; EMA200; consecutive-loss history.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: BTCUSD M1; Jan 2026 backtest; also XAUUSD M1 usage note.
why_new_for_mis: Orthogonal multi-axis tradeability sensor: structure×consensus×conviction×regime-prior×trend×loss-streak as one pass/fail MIS gate stack.
quote: it filters signals across orthogonal dimensions. Each gate evaluates an independent aspect of market quality. A signal must pass ALL six gates to execute.

mechanism: Track unbroken losing streak; at max_consecutive_losses (default 3) set killswitch_until=now+cooldown (300s), reset counter, block all signals until cooldown expires. Framed as early symptom of regime transitions missed by entropy gate plus revenge-trade brake.
data_needed: Per-trade PnL via RecordResult; consecutive_loss counter; cooldown timestamp.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: BTCUSD M1 prop-firm context; 60s signal cadence.
why_new_for_mis: Outcome-based change sensor that fires when structure gates lag—MIS can treat loss streaks as soft regime-break alarms.
quote: it stops trading during regime transitions that other gates may miss; consecutive losses are an early symptom.

mechanism: Shared causal feature module: multi-scale returns (1/4/16), ATR_pct, RSI, Stoch_K, BB_pctB, BB_width_norm=(band_width/rolling50_mean)-1 clipped, EMA_dist/ATR, MACD_norm/ATR, ADX/100, vol_z on tick_volume (96-bar z), tod_sin/cos. BB_width_norm and ATR_pct encode vol regime; ADX trend strength; vol_z liquidity/activity anomaly. Fed as LOOKBACK=16 window to PPO.
data_needed: XAUUSD M15 OHLCV+tick_volume; MAX_WARMUP_BARS=120; identical features.py train/live.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: XAUUSD M15 (~4y, 143999 bars); cross-asset tests USDJPY, XAGUSD, US500, XTIUSD.
why_new_for_mis: Compact stationary vol/trend/volume/session feature pack already framed as regime-aware observation for sequential agents—reusable MIS sensors without RL.
quote: BB_width_norm — volatility regime.... ADX — trend strength.... vol_z — tick-volume anomaly

mechanism: Before RL: LightGBM on triple-barrier labels (ATR×1.5 up/down, horizon 24) with purged walk-forward folds (embargo=horizon). Mean AUC≥0.535=signal, 0.515–0.535=weak, else no signal—stop project. Author's XAUUSD M15 TA+cross-asset features scored ~0.50–0.517 (coin flip).
data_needed: OHLCV+ATR; feature matrix; purged folds; AUC ranking metric.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: XAUUSD M15; horizons 4/8/12/24; optional USDJPY/XAGUSD/US500/XTIUSD features.
why_new_for_mis: Meta-sensor that asks whether any directional information exists in a feature set before committing model capacity—useful MIS feature-audit gate.
quote: If the baseline is around a coin flip, you can learn this very quickly and spend your time on better features, a different target, or maybe a different market.

mechanism: Rolling Windows Eigenvector Comparison: normalize Johansen cointegration vectors, measure consecutive cosine similarity / angle; angle_deg<30 marks hedge-ratio stability. DuckDB array_cosine_similarity+LAG vectorizes vs Python loop (~23×). Drift triggers rebalance; paired with Chow/CUSUM structural-break monitors from earlier parts.
data_needed: Rolling Johansen eigenvectors per basket; cosine/angle time series; optional DuckDB OLAP over large history.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Nasdaq semiconductor baskets (series); H4 screening focus; multi-symbol multi-TF growth path.
why_new_for_mis: Direct sensor of cointegration-relationship change—MIS can flag when pair/basket hedge ratios rotate before spread trades fail.
quote: stable: angle_deg < 30 # Threshold.... DuckDB is 22.9x faster for RWEC logic.

mechanism: CAppDialog risk panel: Close All/Winners/Losers, floating PnL+swap label, auto-flatten at user profit target; magic/symbol filters; OnTimer 1s updates. No market-structure or predictive sensing.
why_new_for_mis: Full read: execution UI/risk chrome only—no regime, vol, liquidity, or neural sensing idea for MIS.
quote: provide a one-click, on-chart control that displays live floating P/L, executes bulk and conditional closures

mechanism: Load daily PnL CSVs per EA; NxN Pearson matrix on aligned daily returns; flag |r|≥0.60 dangerous, <0.35 excellent; hour(0-23)+weekday coverage map; asset-family diversity (FOREX/INDICES/METALS/ENERGY/STOCKS); composite=0.5 corr + 0.25 coverage + 0.25 diversity. Extension: rolling 60-day correlations for unstable co-movement.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Example portfolio EA_EUR, EA_NDX, EA_XAU, EA_OIL, EA_JPY; scenarios EURUSD H1, GBPUSD H1, AUDUSD H4.
why_new_for_mis: Cross-strategy co-movement and temporal-blind-spot sensor—MIS can score whether multiple edges are actually one concentrated risk factor.
quote: portfolio quality is not the sum of individual strategy quality. It is a function of how those strategies interact.

mechanism: DailySwapInAccountCurrency across SYMBOL_SWAP_MODE variants → ExpectedSwapForPosition with Wednesday×3 heuristic → IsWorthHolding: isolate price_pnl=PROFIT−SWAP; if underwater, hold iff accrued+expected carry covers coverage_pct (default 40%) of floating loss. CarryAdjustedLotSize sizes so target carry fraction of risk_money.
data_needed: Live SYMBOL_SWAP_LONG/SHORT/MODE; lots; hold_days; POSITION_PROFIT/SWAP; optional CSV historical swaps for tester.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: AUDJPY H1 (2021–2022 demo); NZDUSD and high-interest pairs; swing 3–7 day holds.
why_new_for_mis: Funding/carry income as a first-class hold-worthiness sensor—MIS can treat overnight interest differential as a soft edge offsetting adverse price moves.
quote: will the swap income expected over the remaining holding window recover enough of that loss to justify staying in the trade?

mechanism: Bullish FVG when origin high < confirm low; bearish when origin low > confirm high (indices: origin i, displacement i-1, confirm i-2). Nested look-ahead marks mitigated if later low≤origin_high (bull) or high≥origin_low (bear); only unmitigated rectangles drawn. Optional volume>20-bar average on displacement; HTF alignment recommended.
data_needed: CopyRates OHLC history depth; optional tick volume; per-symbol/TF CFVGScanner instance.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Any symbol/PERIOD_CURRENT; encourages H1 baseline + M5 execution dual scanners.
why_new_for_mis: Explicit liquidity-void / imbalance zone sensor with fill-state—MIS can track active vs exhausted gaps as liquidity microstructure features.
quote: A Fair Value Gap is strictly a three-candle formation that exposes a temporary lack of liquidity on one side of the market order book.

mechanism: CRegimeClassifier: ATR% of close over 500-bar lookback → p20/p80; if atr_pct>p80 → VOLATILE; else if ADX>25 → TREND; else if ADX<20 and atr_pct<p20 → RANGE; else NORMAL. Empirically on US_TECH100 H1 raw MACD: VOLATILE best expectancy (+0.042R), TREND weakest positive, RANGE negative—so filtering VOLATILE hurt.
data_needed: iADX(14), iATR(14); 500-bar ATR% window; thresholds 25/20 and 80th/20th percentiles.
why_new_for_mis: Adaptive ADX×vol-percentile regime taxonomy with broker-native calibration warning that 'trend=good/volatile=bad' can invert—MIS should score regimes empirically per instrument.
quote: if(atr_pct_now > p80) return(REGIME_VOLATILE); if(adx_now > m_adx_trend_th) return(REGIME_TREND); if(adx_now < m_adx_range_th && atr_pct_now < p20) return(REGIME_RANGE);

mechanism: Only accept MACD histogram crossover signals during 14:00–20:00 broker time (NYSE cash). Alone among regime/HTF/session stack, session filter moved expectancy +0.007R→+0.100R and cut max DD −29.6R→−9.7R by dropping thin overnight TECH100 liquidity.
data_needed: Bar hour in broker time; MACD 12-26-9; ATR SL/TP 2.5/3.0.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: US_TECH100 H1; notes EURUSD/London and Crude need different windows.
why_new_for_mis: Session-as-liquidity-quality sensor that dominated statistical filters on this index—MIS should treat time-of-day liquidity as a first-class gate, instrument-specific.
quote: execution quality and signal reliability are a function of liquidity.... the session filter is what changed everything.

mechanism: Partition S_q(T,Δt)=mean(|aggregated non-overlapping log-returns|^q) over log-spaced Δt∈[1,150] and q∈[0.01,30]; OLS log S_q vs log Δt; mean R²≥0.60 confirms multifractal moment scaling before MMAR. Crossover detector finds Δt where truncated R²≥0.85 (microstructure floor). Non-overlapping intervals avoid artificial autocorrelation.
data_needed: Log returns from MT5 OHLCV; Δt/q grids; MIN_R_SQUARED=0.60.
why_new_for_mis: Honest fractality precondition sensor—MIS can refuse multifractal vol models when scaling R² fails, avoiding expensive false structure.
quote: if the data is fractal, then log(S_q) should be a linear function of log(delta_t) for each q.... If the data fails this test, the MMAR should not be used.

mechanism: Build multifractal trading time θ(t) via binary multiplicative cascade (k levels, multipliers from fitted Normal/Binomial/Poisson/Gamma spectrum); generate FBM via Davies-Harte (FFT) with Hurst H; X(t)=B_H[θ(t)] by linear interpolation; 1000 MC sims → mean std of synthetic returns as vol forecast. On EURUSD M5 OOS 25d, MMAR error 64% vs GARCH 194%. Captures long memory, fat tails, clustering, scale consistency.
data_needed: Fitted H + spectrum params from Parts 1–2; cascade b=2; sample vol for FBM scale; FORECAST_LENGTH≈7200 M5 bars.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EURUSD M5; 25-day forecast vs realized vol; Zhang 2017 methodology.
why_new_for_mis: Multiscale generative vol sensor beyond GARCH clustering—MIS gets trading-time deformation + long-memory FBM forecasts with CI when fractality holds.
quote: X(t) = B_H[theta(t)].... MMAR reduces percentage error by 129.44 pp.... BEST MODEL: MMAR (Error: 64.43%)

mechanism: Python: StandardScaler+PCA(n_components retaining ~99% var) then LSTMRegressor → ONNX. MQL5: load means/scales/PCA matrix once; per bar build features (close diffs, SMA12, multi-MACD main/signal and deltas); TransformPCA=(data−scaler_mean)/scaler_scale−pca_mean then MatMul components; OnnxRun. Ensures identical input space train↔live.
data_needed: Exported scaler/PCA binaries; lstm3.onnx; SMA+MACD handles; float feature vector.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: EA on chart symbol/TimeFrame; tester run reported 52 trades, PF 2.56 (illustrative).
why_new_for_mis: Production pattern for MIS neural sensors: compressed PCA state + sequence model with terminal-side matrix parity so live features cannot silently diverge.
quote: it is in the terminal that it is necessary to reproduce the same data path used during training.... PCA becomes an intermediate layer between raw market data and the model.
